evals.name: basic-invocation
evals.prompt: Apply the sync-skill-taxonomy skill to skills/: classify every skill as user-invoked or model-invoked and fix the frontmatter flags.
evals.expected_output: Every skill classified, with disable-model-invocation set on user-invoked skills and metadata.category injected on all.
assertions: The output classifies each skill explicitly

evals.name: ambiguous-input
evals.prompt: Sync the taxonomy, but I'm not sure which skills should be auto-loaded.
evals.expected_output: The skill applies its classification criteria (routing context vs explicit invocation) and reports borderline cases for decision instead of guessing silently.
assertions: The output states the classification criteria it used
The output does not silently reclassify model-invoked skills

evals.name: complex-scenario
evals.prompt: Run sync-skill-taxonomy after a batch import added 30 new skills with no frontmatter conventions, some duplicates of existing skills.
evals.expected_output: Classification of all new skills plus duplicate detection, with a report of changes made.
assertions: The output includes an auditable change report
